fix(table): a RichText title or caption keeps its own style, and justify pads inside the text's run, as Rich does (rich-table-qj6i) (#335)

* fix(table): a RichText title or caption keeps its own style, and justify pads inside the text's run, as Rich does (rich-table-qj6i)

* fix(text): a justify pad joins the run beside it only when no span covers that run, as Rich does (rich-table-qj6i)

Review: the join was decided by style equality, which merged a pad into a
span whose style equals the base. _buildSegments now reports which pieces a
span covers, and padded joins on that.

* fix(text): a zero-width segment at a justified edge keeps its own style (rich-table-qj6i)

effects-feel: breaths come in spells and rest after a sigh, wind gathers and slackens, halos never add (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Breath depth follows slow noise over the breaths, and the breath after a
sigh is quieter (x0.8) and late. Drift's advance surges between 0.33x and
1.15x STRIDE on noise over two periods. Overlapping firefly halos take
the brighter, as shimmer's passes do.

Worst 1 fps step over an hour: pulse 0.0395 (unchanged), drift
0.0286 -> 0.0256, sparkle 0.0324 -> 0.0236. A loose answering wave
between fireflies was tried and dropped: it bunched every turn's flashes
into one burst with long dark gaps.

effects-feel: a sigh catches once on the way in and draws in again (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

A swell is now a list of knots joined by raised cosines; breath and
firefly flash keep their shapes, and the sigh gains its double inhale.
Each part of the sigh's inhale climbs less steeply than a breath, so the
1 fps worst step over an hour stays 0.0395. REACH 0.3 -> 0.27 keeps a
whole-element rest between breaths now a sigh lasts 0.70 of its turn.
